title: eludite.debug.quickwatch input
description: Visual Studio's QuickWatch (Shift+F9; brief 0077): open the QuickWatch dialog on an expression and evaluate it in the selected frame (context `watch`). Needs break mode. Answers like eludite.debug.evaluate (`pending` from the UI; the value once it arrives for an agent).

expression.description: Default: the active document's selection, else the expression at the caret.
